notes.title: Update v1.0.2
notes.content:
+ Further Reductions in Memory Usage
       - IMO This is still the most likely cause of the "Generating Reef" freeze for people. Again I still don't know what the root of the problem is exactly but will keep doing what I can to find a solution.
+ Reduced spawn rate of sharks and whales
+ Health automatically replenishes after time

notes.title: v1.0.1 First Update
notes.content:
+Reduced Memory Usage
+Reduced Game File Size
+Fixed Unpossessable Animals
+Fixed Orange Sphere showing up randomly
+Increased spawning of whale sharks and cuttlefish
+Doubled the time it takes to run out of oxygen and hunger
+Added a maximum spawn height for each species preventing them from spawning on land (except crab) and keeping larger animals from spawning in the shallows.
+New Quality Setting - Underwater Effect: Controls intensity of wobbly effect on screen when underwater.
+New Gameplay Setting - Invert Camera Input - Reverses the look direction of the camera input
+Various small bug fixes
+Several improvements aimed at fixing the "Generating Reef" freeze but no certain fix.
